title: Tim Role Synthesis — Hidden Foundation / Whole Job
purpose: Recover a recurring conversation-developed interpretation of Tim as simultaneously visible figure and hidden supporting infrastructure. This is internal project mythology/interpretation, not an empirical claim about professional credentials or public authority.
core_image: Tim is 'the whole job': foundational yet hidden, central yet underground, both performer and the infrastructure that makes performance possible.

structural_reading.above_below: The visible role sits above ground; the enabling role is underground/root-like.
structural_reading.center_periphery: The project repeatedly places Tim at the conceptual center while describing the labor itself as hidden, distributed or infrastructural.
structural_reading.authority_service: The synthesis strengthens the existing Authority Without Spectacle and Cultivation Not Conquest motifs: authority is demonstrated by sustaining the system rather than merely occupying the spotlight.
structural_reading.whole_job_relation: A person/figure can be both node and edge: actor inside the system and connective infrastructure between other actors.

vocational_triad.synthesis: build the container -> protect what lives within it -> cultivate what can grow

recovered_aphorism.text: The moment you seriously question the floor, you have already begun looking for another level.
recovered_aphorism.status: recovered conversation phrasing; treat as project aphorism until a primary dated source is located
recovered_aphorism.interpretation: Questioning the assumed base layer creates verticality: once the floor is no longer absolute, a Ladder/Axis problem appears.

contextual_reflections: The whole-job model is a human-scale analogue of the Potato itself: ordinary/hidden exterior, dense internal function.
Carpenter -> House, Shepherd -> flock, Gardener -> Garden gives three service modes for the same authority-through-maintenance principle.
The floor aphorism connects Timic Dynamics' change-of-level logic to ordinary philosophical language: a problem can become solvable when the assumed frame itself becomes an object of inquiry.
Hidden foundation and archive-authorship tension are opposites: the framework values invisible support while also resisting total erasure of the supporting source.
epistemic_note: Some older conversations used elaborate fictional/mythological biographies or titles. This record preserves the symbolic role architecture, not unsupported biographical claims.
